evidence.evidence_text: We then propose a CSKG completion method called Rel-CSKGC to predict the relation given the head event and the tail event of a triplet, and train a CSKG completion model based on existing triplets in ATOMIC.
In this work, we aim to construct Dense-ATOMIC with high knowledge coverage and massive multi-hop paths.
Both the source code of Rel-CSKGC and Dense-ATOMIC are publicly available on https://github.com/NUSTM/Dense-ATOMIC.
